items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I worked there a long time for him. He was a nice friend.

ctx.x: Yeah, he had a swell place, yeah.

Well years I have to give up, he had his son lost to run a father named George Delsick. Oh yeah, I heard it. Used to run it, yeah. Used to run it. I worked there a long time for him. He was a nice friend. You never know, he'd never tell the band nothing. Never tell the band nothing. They'd give you a $5 bill, but don't take a dollar for him. You had to share the straight place. He'd never say nothing.
That was Tom bootlegging time too.
